purpose: 生成音乐：当前四境 HD-2D 的空灵探索 BGM 与低存在感风声
arguments: Pure instrumental exploration BGM for a pixel-art HD-2D world blending lantern-lit streets, cool neon, an eastern courtyard and woodland. Gentle felt piano plays a sparse memorable melody over soft electronic pads, with occasional delicate guzheng plucks and breathy wooden flute. Calm, spacious and quietly curious, around 76 BPM, warm against a cool nighttime mood. Restrained arrangement and even dynamics, about three minutes with a gentle looping transition. Musical instruments only: no recorded rain, wind, nature sounds, tape hiss, vocals, prominent drums or dramatic swells. Weather ambience will be played separately by the game.
